name: cobol-oo-statement-shape-heuristic
body: oo_statement_at stops an operand or condition scan at INVOKE only when it is followed by a receiver and a method literal or name, and at RAISE only when followed by EXCEPTION or a name, and only under an OO dialect, so an INVOKE or RAISE used as a data name stays an operand. Limit: under an OO dialect an operand sequence shaped like INVOKE name literal is split into its own statement. Upgrade to a scope-aware check against declared data names if a corpus shows such operands.
